text: Hello, im so sorry to bother anyone this late, I'm looking after my nephew whos 6 and I really dont want to waste your time if its nothing. He's had a temperature today and its 39 now. Tonight I noticed some spots and Im not sure what to make of them. He has dark skin so its hard to see anything on his body, so I looked at the paler bits like the palms of his hands and the bottoms of his feet and inside his bottom eyelid, and there are these tiny little dots, kind of dark red going purplish, and a couple of bigger bits that look a bit like bruises. I read online about pressing a glass on them so I tried with the side of a glass and I think they didnt go away at all, I could still see them through the glass clearly. I might be doing it wrong I honestly dont know. His neck seems ok, I asked him to look down at his tummy and he could do it fine. His mum is away till tomorrow and I dont want to panic her over nothing. Sorry again for the long message, I just wasnt sure who else to ask
